Body HTML:
The Eaton Wheelock MIZ-24S-W is a compact piezoelectric mini horn for indoor wall mounting in fire alarm notification circuits. Part of the Wheelock MIZ family, it gives designers a small, low-current audible appliance where a full-size horn is unnecessary, and its white finish blends into offices, corridors and finished interiors.

Key Features

  • Field-selectable Temporal (Code 3) or Continuous horn output
  • 87 dBA minimum anechoic sound output at 24 VDC on both Temporal and Continuous settings
  • Synchronized Code 3 horn tone when used with Wheelock sync modules or Wheelock power supplies
  • Operates on filtered DC or unfiltered full-wave-rectified power
  • Mounts on a standard single-gang electrical backbox with no trim plate or adapter required
  • Reverse-polarity supervision with IN/OUT wiring terminals

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Eaton Wheelock
  • Part Number: MIZ-24S-W
  • Type: Piezoelectric mini horn
  • Nominal Voltage: 24 VDC (listed range 16–33 V)
  • Tones: Temporal (Code 3) / Continuous
  • Wire Gauge: #12 to #18 AWG
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C), indoor use only
  • Dimensions: 4.50" H x 2.75" W x 1.28" D
  • Color: White
  • Mounting: Wall
  • Listing: UL 464 (Audible Appliances for Public Mode Fire Protection Systems)

Designed for spaces where normal ambient temperatures run too high for a standard heat detector, the Notifier FST-951H is a low-profile intelligent thermal sensor factory preset to a 190°F fixed alarm point. It belongs to Notifier's FST-951 Series, the direct replacement for the FST-851 Series, and communicates on FlashScan signaling line circuits only.

Key Features

  • Fixed-temperature alarm point of 190°F (88°C), factory preset
  • Thermistor technology for fast response with built-in device-type identification
  • Rotary decimal switches set the point address for exact location reporting
  • Two LEDs with 360° visibility: blink red when polled, steady red in alarm
  • Built-in tamper-resistant feature and magnet-activated functional test switch
  • Plugs into a separate base, allowing interchange with photoelectric and ionization sensors

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Notifier
  • Part Number: FST-951H
  • Protocol: FlashScan only
  • Color: White
  • Voltage Range: 15–32 VDC peak
  • Standby Current: 200 µA max. avg. @ 24 VDC
  • Alarm Current: 4.5 mA @ 24 VDC
  • Operating Temperature: –4°F to 150°F (–20°C to 66°C)
  • Relative Humidity: 10%–93% non-condensing
  • Spacing: UL 50 ft center-to-center; FM 25 x 25 ft
  • Height: 2.0 in (base determines diameter)
  • Listings: UL/ULC S747, FM Approved, CSFM 7270-0028:0502

Compatibility

For Notifier FlashScan panels. Mounts on Notifier intelligent bases such as the B300-6 6" flanged base, B501 4" base, and B224RB relay, B224BI isolator and B200S sounder bases. An optional RA100Z remote LED annunciator can be connected. Mount the base on an electrical backbox at least 1.5" deep.

When standby battery requirements outgrow the main fire alarm cabinet, the Notifier NFS-LBB battery cabinet provides a separate enclosure for large sealed lead-acid batteries. Notifier lists it among the enclosure options for its NFS2-3030 intelligent control panel family, where long standby calculations often call for 55 AH batteries.

Key Features

  • Holds up to two 55 AH batteries
  • Separate hinged-door enclosure keeps large batteries out of the control panel cabinet
  • Optional SEISKIT-LBB seismic kit adds a battery bracket for two 55 AH batteries in seismic-certified installations
  • Suitable for installations where the panel enclosure cannot house the required battery size

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Notifier
  • Part Number: NFS-LBB
  • Type: Battery cabinet / battery box
  • Battery Capacity: Up to two 55 AH batteries
  • Box Dimensions: 24" W x 14" H x 7.75" D (610 x 356 x 197 mm)
  • Door Dimensions: 24.125" W x 14.25" H (613 x 362 mm); door adds approx. 0.0625" to depth
  • Seismic Accessory: SEISKIT-LBB (sold separately)

Compatibility

Listed as an accessory in Notifier's NFS2-3030 control panel literature. Confirm battery size against your panel's charger capacity and battery calculation.

Large Simplex fire alarm systems with long standby requirements rely on high-capacity secondary power, and the Simplex 2081-9279 supplies it as a 12 V DC, 110 Ah rechargeable sealed lead-acid battery. It is intended for Simplex control panels with chargers capable of up to 110 Ah, mounted in the external 2081-9280 battery cabinet close-nippled to the panel.

Key Features

  • 110 Ah capacity at 12 V DC for extended standby operation
  • Two batteries connected in series produce a 24 V system voltage
  • High-current post output terminals; connecting hardware is included with the battery cabinet
  • UL 924 recognized pressure relief valves
  • Satisfies UL, ULC and FM fire alarm requirements when used with a compatible charger and battery cabinet
  • Recyclable battery chemicals and materials

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Simplex
  • Part Number: 2081-9279
  • Type: Sealed lead-acid (SLA), rechargeable
  • Voltage: 12 V DC
  • Capacity: 110 Ah
  • Quantity for 24 V System: 2 (series-connected)
  • Required Enclosure: 2081-9280 external battery cabinet (ordered separately)

Compatibility

For Simplex fire alarm control panels whose chargers can charge 110 Ah batteries, including 4100ES System Power Supplies, 4100ES remote and TrueAlert addressable power supplies, and 4100 legacy power supplies 4100-0104, 4100-0114 and 4100-0124. On 4100ES/4100U systems, batteries connect through a 4100-5128 Battery Distribution Terminal Block. The 2081-9280 cabinet is not applicable to ULC-listed 4100ES/4100U systems. Battery sets must match in voltage, model and approximate date of manufacture.

Built for outdoor evacuation signaling, the Gentex WGEC24-75WRLP from the Outdoor Commander Series pairs a 24 VDC horn/strobe with a fixed 75 candela strobe and ships with the low-profile GOELP weatherproof enclosure. The red-faceplate wall-mount unit suits building exteriors, loading docks, courtyards and other locations exposed to the weather.

Key Features

  • Fixed 75 cd strobe with a minimum 1 Hz flash rate regardless of input voltage
  • Switch selection for mechanical or 2400 Hz tone, continuous or Temporal 3 pattern, and high or low dBA
  • Separate horn and strobe functions; synchronize using the Gentex AVSM control module
  • Clear Lexan GOELP enclosure resists moisture and allows full 75 cd output
  • Super-Slide 4" mounting plate for supervision testing and Checkmate instant voltage verification
  • Tamperproof re-entrant grille; input terminals accept 12 to 18 AWG

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Gentex
  • Part Number: WGEC24-75WRLP (904-1257-002)
  • Nominal Voltage: 24 VDC
  • Input Voltage Range: 16–33 VDC or FWR
  • Candela: 75 cd fixed
  • Sound Output: 70–82 dBA reverberant @ 10 ft (ANSI/UL 464); 100 dBA anechoic @ 10 ft
  • Enclosure: GOELP, 5.75" H x 4.75" W x 3.25" D
  • Outdoor Operating Temperature: –31°F to 150°F (–35°C to 66°C)
  • Faceplate: Red
  • Mounting: Wall
  • Listings: ANSI/UL 464 and ANSI/UL 1638; listed for outdoor use with the GOE/GOELP enclosure

Edwards packages its EST3X life safety control platform as the 3X-SFS1R, a complete fire alarm control panel with user interface, CPU, one signaling loop, three option card slots and a universal 10 A power supply behind a red door. EST3X is aimed at mid- to large-sized buildings and can run standalone or networked with up to 64 nodes.

Key Features

  • One Signature loop installed, with a second loop added by ordering the 3-SDC1 card
  • Four built-in 3 A Class B notification/auxiliary circuits, synchronized to UL 1971
  • Universal 110/220 V (94–264 VAC) 10 A power supply with patented Voltage Boost technology
  • Large 24-line by 40-character backlit LCD with SpeedTouch rotary control
  • Three option card slots for extra SLC loops, amplifiers or dialer/modem cards
  • Form C alarm, supervisory and trouble relays; English-language interface

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Edwards (EST)
  • Part Number: 3X-SFS1R
  • Door Color: Red
  • Language: English
  • Loops: 1 installed; 2nd loop requires 3-SDC1
  • Loop Capacity: 125 detectors and 125 single-address modules per SLC
  • NACs: 4 Class B, 3 A each
  • Power Supply: 94–264 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 10 A (UL)
  • Battery Charging: 65 Ah max.
  • Operating Environment: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C), 0–93% RH non-condensing

Compatibility

Works with Edwards Signature Series detectors and modules and supports up to 30 R-Series remote annunciators per node. Networks with other EST3X panels or an EST3 network of up to 64 nodes using optional 3X-NET or 3X-NET8 network cards.

One appliance can cover many room sizes. The Gentex GHSR (904-1459-002) is a Commander 5 Series horn/strobe with a tamperproof, field-selectable candela setting, so installers set the required output on site. The red-faceplate universal mount unit installs on walls or ceilings on 24 VDC notification circuits.

Key Features

  • Six field-selectable candela settings: 15, 30, 75, 115, 150 and 177 cd
  • Switch-selectable continuous or temporal 2400 Hz, mechanical or chime tones, plus a continuous whoop tone
  • High or low dBA selection; temporal tones synchronize with the Gentex GTSM control module
  • Super-Slide bracket for supervision testing before the signal is installed
  • Checkmate instant voltage verification without removing the device
  • Tamperproof re-entrant grille; surface mounts with the Gentex GBB indoor back box

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Gentex
  • Part Number: GHSR (904-1459-002)
  • Nominal Voltage: 24 VDC (16–33 VDC range)
  • Candela: 15 / 30 / 75 / 115 / 150 / 177 cd selectable
  • Strobe: LED, 1 Hz flash rate
  • Sound Output: 64–88 dBA reverberant @ 10 ft (ANSI/UL 464)
  • Dimensions: 5.91" x 5.91" x 2.56"
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C), indoor only
  • Faceplate: Red
  • Mounting: Universal wall/ceiling
  • Listings: ANSI/UL 464, ANSI/UL 1638, CAN/ULC 525 and/or 526, CSFM

The Gamewell-FCI 1100-0503 ANU-48 is an LED driver module that turns a remote UL-listed annunciator enclosure into a custom status and control point for Gamewell-FCI systems. It works with the E3 Series Expandable Emergency Evacuation System, the E3 Series Combined Fire and Mass Notification System and the E3 Series Broadband Voice Evacuation system. Gamewell-FCI documentation also lists the S3 Series panel.

Key Features

  • Outputs for up to 48 remote LEDs or driver circuits
  • Inputs for eight software-programmable switches
  • Switches can serve as speaker circuit, firefighter phone or auxiliary On-Off-Auto control functions
  • Can be installed up to 3,000 ft (914.4 m) from the control panel
  • Up to 16 ANU-48 or ASM-16 modules per INI-VG, ILI-MB-E3/ILI95-MB-E3 or SLP (128 switches, 768 LEDs)
  • Mounts in any remotely located UL-listed annunciator enclosure

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Gamewell-FCI
  • Part Number: 1100-0503 (ANU-48)
  • Operating Voltage: 24 VDC resettable
  • Operating Current: 0.011 A (add 0.003 A per lit LED when powered internally)
  • External Power Driver Output: 0.050 A max. per circuit; 2.4 A max. per module
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C)
  • Relative Humidity: 0–93% non-condensing at 90°F
  • Listings: UL 864 10th Edition (S1869); UL 2572 2nd Edition for Mass Notification

Compatibility

Used with Gamewell-FCI E3 Series (fire, mass notification and broadband voice evacuation) and S3 Series systems. Installations with more than four ANU-48 modules require an external regulated, Class 2 power-limited power supply listed for fire protective signaling.

The Silent Knight SD505-6RB is a 6" relay base that adds a relay output to an addressable detector in Silent Knight IntelliKnight systems. It lets a detector location control auxiliary functions such as elevator recall, door closing, fan operation and auxiliary notification, anywhere on the signaling line circuit.

Key Features

  • One Form C relay contact rated 8.0 A for normally open or normally closed applications
  • Fully supervised operation
  • Supports Class B (Style 4) or Class A (Style 6) wiring
  • Mounts to a standard single- or double-gang electrical box
  • Very low SLC current draw of 0.082 mA

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Silent Knight
  • Part Number: SD505-6RB
  • Base Size: 6 in
  • Relay Rating: 8.0 A @ 30 VDC; 8.0 A @ 120/240 VAC (Form C)
  • SLC Current Draw: 0.082 mA
  • Max. SLC Loop Resistance: 50 Ω
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C)
  • Listings: UL Listed, CSFM Listed

Compatibility

For use with Silent Knight addressable sensors SD505-APS (photoelectric), SD505-AIS (ionization) and SD505-AHS (heat). Detector sold separately.

Where a sturdy initiating device is wanted, the Siemens HMS-M (500-033450) manual pull station combines a metal housing with a single-action pull-down lever. It is a field-installed addressable device with two-way communication to Siemens FireFinder-XLS and FS-250 control panels, giving each station its own point on the device loop. It suits corridors, exits and other locations where a durable, clearly identifiable manual station is required.

Key Features

  • Metal housing and cover with PULL DOWN lever
  • Single-action operation; converts to double action with the Siemens MS-FD adapter
  • Addressable intelligent initiating device with two-way panel communication
  • Polarity-insensitive loop wiring
  • Key-reset lock barrel (Allen key supplied)

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Siemens
  • Part Number: HMS-M (500-033450)
  • Type: Addressable manual pull station
  • Action: Single action
  • Housing: Metal
  • Mounting: Siemens MS-FB backbox or user-supplied single-gang switchbox

Compatibility

Operates with the Siemens FireFinder-XLS or FS-250 control panel through the DLC or FS-DLC device loop card.

Individually addressed and supervised, the Simplex 49AV-WRF is a TrueAlert ES wall-mount horn/strobe in a red housing with white "FIRE" lettering and a clear lens. It gets power, supervision and control from Simplex IDNAC signaling line circuits, so horn and strobe operate separately on a single two-wire circuit.

Key Features

  • Multi-candela xenon strobe: 15/30/75/110/135/185 cd, set by jumper or from the control unit, with synchronized 1 Hz flash
  • Horn patterns: Temporal Code 3, Temporal Code 4, March Time or continuous; high/low output selectable
  • Self-Test mode: on-board sensors check strobe and horn output and report status to the FACU
  • Magnet Test diagnostics and an appliance LED that can indicate polling or address
  • Class B circuits can be T-tapped; separate mounting plate allows pre-wiring
  • Mounts on single-gang, double-gang or 4 in. square boxes, flush or surface

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Simplex
  • Part Number: 49AV-WRF
  • Series: TrueAlert ES addressable
  • Color / Marking: Red housing, "FIRE" lettering, clear lens
  • Mounting: Wall
  • Operating Voltage: 23–31 VDC (special application), from 29 VDC regulated IDNAC SLC
  • Candela: 15/30/75/110/135/185 cd
  • Sound Output: 90.1 dBA steady/high reverberant (UL 464) @ 10 ft
  • Dimensions: 5 1/8" H x 5" W x 2 5/8" D with cover
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 122°F (0°C to 50°C)
  • Listings: Strobe UL 1971/ULC S526; horn UL 464/ULC S525; CSFM 7125-0026:0373; FM Approved

Compatibility

Compatible with Simplex IDNAC SLC controllers: 4100ES with EPS+ or EPS power supply, 4009 IDNAC Repeater, 4007ES with IDNAC notification and 4010ES with ESS Enhanced System Supply. Maximum of 127 addresses (139 unit loads) per SLC.

The Mircom UDACT-300A lets a Mircom panel report to a central station over two telephone lines. This digital alarm communicator transmitter/dialer module allows FA-1000 Series, FX-2000 and FleX-Net Series fire alarm control panels to transmit alarm, supervisory and trouble information to a monitoring facility. It mounts in a dedicated location in the panel's main chassis and takes its power from the host panel.

Key Features

  • Dual telephone line operation with line supervision at roughly one-minute intervals
  • Reports in Ademco Contact ID and SIA-DCS formats
  • DACT mode sends common events; UDACT mode sends point-specific alarm, supervisory, waterflow and trouble data
  • ZDACT feature groups FX-2000/FleX-Net input circuits into software zones for reporting
  • Programmed on site with the CFG-300 tool or UIMA, or remotely by modem (passcode protected)
  • 500-entry event logs, reviewable locally or remotely

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Mircom
  • Part Number: UDACT-300A
  • Panel Interface: RS-485 data link
  • Telephone Lines: 2
  • Reporting Formats: Ademco Contact ID, SIA-DCS
  • Current Consumption: Standby 40 mA; Alarm 60 mA
  • Power: Supplied by host fire alarm control panel

Compatibility

For Mircom FA-1000 Series, FX-2000 and FleX-Net Series fire alarm control panels. The CFG-300 Configuration Tool is needed for on-site programming.

Scalable intelligent detection for small to mid-sized buildings is the job of the Kidde FX-1000. This FX-Series control panel ships with one 250-point loop installed and grows to 1,000 points with loop controller cards. It comes as a complete 120 V system with four NACs and a red surface-mount enclosure.

Key Features

  • One 250-point Class A or Class B loop (125 detectors + 125 modules) installed
  • Expandable to four loops and 1,000 points with FX-SLC1 or FX-SLC2 loop controller modules
  • Four NACs (Class B, or two Class A) individually configurable for continuous, temporal, synchronized or coded output
  • 4 x 20 character backlit LCD, two programmable switches and rotary device addressing
  • Supports up to eight serial annunciators; optional SA-ETH Ethernet and SA-DACT2 dialer
  • Pre-alarm, alarm verification by point and adjustable detector sensitivity

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Kidde
  • Part Number: FX-1000
  • Capacity: 1,000 points (one 250-point loop installed)
  • NAC Output: 24 VFWR; 6.0 A total, 2.5 A max. per circuit at 120 VAC 60 Hz
  • Primary Power: 120 VAC
  • Batteries: 24 VDC SLA; two 18 Ah batteries fit in cabinet; 26 Ah charging capacity
  • Enclosure: Surface mount, red
  • Operating Environment: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C), 0–93% RH non-condensing

Compatibility

Supports Kidde intelligent addressable detectors, modules and bases; see the FX-64 and FX-1000 Series Compatibility List (P/N 3102355-EN). The RZI16-2RS module adds up to 16 conventional circuits and two NACs for retrofits.

Dedicated power for VESDA-E VEA aspirating detection comes from the VPS-VEA-115UL power supply StaX. It converts 120 VAC to 24 VDC nominal operating power for the VEA detector and VEA Relay StaX, and it charges and supervises the standby batteries. It is intended for applications requiring UL and ULC fire protective signaling listings.

Key Features

  • Filtered, electronically regulated 27 VDC output: 2.8 A continuous, 5 A alarm
  • Built-in charger for sealed lead-acid or gel batteries with automatic switchover on AC failure
  • AC fail, brown-out and battery supervision
  • Form C fault relay for AC loss, low AC, battery loss and shorted battery or DC outputs
  • Cabinet space for two 36 Ah batteries (supplied separately)
  • AC input LED indicator

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: VESDA (Xtralis)
  • Part Number: VPS-VEA-115UL
  • Input: 120 VAC, 2.0 A, 60 Hz
  • Output: 27 VDC / 2.8 A continuous; 27 VDC / 5 A alarm
  • Max. Charging Current: 5.3 A
  • Max. Battery Capacity for Charging: 108 Ah
  • Trouble Relay: Form C, 2 A @ 30 VDC
  • Dimensions: 17.25" x 13" x 5.6" (438 x 330 x 142 mm)
  • Weight: 13 lb without batteries
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C)
  • Listings: UL 864, ULC-S527, CSFM

Compatibility

Designed to power VESDA-E VEA detectors and VESDA-E VEA Relay StaX. A 230 VAC version (VPS-VEA-230UL) is also available.

Sleeping areas such as hotel rooms, dormitories and apartments need a low-frequency tone, and the System Sensor B200S-LF-IV intelligent sounder base provides it right at the detector. It produces a 520 Hz square-wave tone designed to meet the NFPA 72 sleeping space requirement. The ivory base picks up the attached sensor's address, so the panel can sound it individually or in groups.

Key Features

  • 520 Hz ±10% square-wave tone, a frequency shown to be effective at waking sleeping occupants
  • Two volume levels: 75 or 85 dBA
  • Continuous, ANSI Temporal 3, ANSI Temporal 4 and March Time tones
  • Synchronizes with other System Sensor notification devices
  • Pre-wire mounting plate fits various junction box sizes
  • Mechanical locking feature prevents removal of the attached sensor head

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: System Sensor
  • Part Number: B200S-LF-IV
  • Color: Ivory
  • External Supply Voltage: 16–33 VDC (VFWR)
  • External Standby Current: 550 µA max.
  • Alarm Current (High): 90 mA max. @ 24 VDC
  • Alarm Current (Low): 20 mA max. @ 24 VDC
  • SLC Operating Voltage: 15–32 VDC
  • Base Dimensions: 6.875" diameter x 2.0" high (less sensor)
  • Humidity: 10%–93% RH non-condensing
  • Standards: UL 268 and UL 464; CSFM 7300-1653:0238

Compatibility

Listed as a compatible intelligent base in Notifier FST-951 Series (FlashScan) literature and in Gamewell-FCI Velociti Series literature for E3 Series, S3 Series and GWF-7075 panels. Confirm compatibility with your panel documentation.

The VESDA VSP-964-04 is the MK4 spare smoke detection chamber for VESDA-E VEU, VEP, VEP-1P and VES aspirating smoke detectors. Service technicians use it to restore a detector in the field without replacing the whole unit, which keeps downtime short in data centers, clean rooms and other high-value spaces. Matching the chamber revision to the detector generation matters, so check the detector serial number before ordering.

Key Features

  • Genuine VESDA-E spare smoke detection chamber, MK4 revision
  • Fits VEU, VEP, VEP-1P and VES detectors
  • Matches GA4 generation detectors (serial numbers starting 109xxxxx)
  • Field-replaceable service part

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: VESDA (Xtralis)
  • Part Number: VSP-964-04
  • Description: Smoke Detection Chamber – MK4
  • Compatible Detectors: VEU, VEP, VEP-1P, VES (GA4)

Compatibility

For GA4 VESDA-E detectors, identified by serial numbers starting 109xxxxx. GA3 detectors (serial numbers starting 97xxxxx, 106xxxx, 107xxxx or 110xxxx) use the MK3 chamber VSP-964-03 instead.

Edwards' iO1000G is an intelligent fire alarm control panel from the iO Series for small to mid-sized buildings, supplied with one loop installed and a grey door. The installed loop supports 125 detectors and 125 modules, and the four-loop system can grow to 1,000 device addresses with added loop controller cards.

Key Features

  • One Class A or Class B Signature loop installed: 125 detectors and 125 modules
  • Expandable in 250-point increments to 1,000 addresses
  • Four NACs (Class B, or two Class A) with Genesis horn silence and UL 1971 strobe synchronization
  • 4 x 20 character backlit LCD with two programmable switches
  • Supports Signature Series detectors, modules, SIGA-REL releasing modules and CO detection
  • Up to eight serial annunciators; optional Ethernet port

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Edwards (EST)
  • Part Number: IO1000G
  • Door Color: Grey
  • Primary Power: 110 V
  • Loops: 1 installed (4-loop system)
  • Loop Capacity: 125 detectors / 125 modules
  • NAC Output: 24 VFWR; 6.0 A total, 2.5 A max. per circuit at 120/230 VAC 60 Hz
  • Batteries: 24 VDC SLA; two 18 Ah fit in cabinet; 26 Ah charging capacity
  • Operating Environment: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C), 0–93% RH non-condensing

Compatibility

Supports Edwards Signature Series intelligent detectors, modules and bases, R-Series remote annunciators and SIGA-REL releasing modules. Add loops with iO-SDC1 or iO-SDC2 loop controller modules.

Duct smoke detection in low-flow air handling systems often calls for a pendant-mounted head. The System Sensor B114LPBT is the 24VAC/DC plug-in base that makes this possible with the 2151 Special Applications Duct Smoke Detector. It is designed for 4-wire systems and includes terminals for alarm and supervisory relays and a remote annunciator.

Key Features

  • 24 VAC/DC system voltage for 4-wire applications
  • Form A and Form C alarm relay contacts plus a Form A supervisory relay
  • Terminals for remote annunciator and remote test coil connections
  • Twist-in/twist-out head for quick cleaning and maintenance
  • Mounts to 4" square, 4" octagon or 3 1/2" octagon boxes (1.5" min. depth)

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: System Sensor
  • Part Number: B114LPBT
  • System Voltage: 24 VAC/DC, 60 Hz
  • Relay Ratings: Form A 2.0 A @ 30 V AC/DC; Form C 2.0 A @ 30 V AC/DC, 1.0 A @ 125 VAC
  • Standby Current: 25 mA typical @ 24 V (base and detector)
  • Alarm Current: 75 mA typical @ 24 V (base and detector)
  • Operating Temperature: 32°F to 120°F (0°C to 49°C)
  • Humidity: 10%–93% RH

Compatibility

For use with the System Sensor 2151 Special Applications Duct Smoke Detector (installation instructions also list 1151 and 2151T heads). With the B114LPBT, the 2151 is listed to UL 268A for no-flow/low-flow air handling systems at air velocities of 0–3,000 FPM.

Voice messages need to be heard outdoors too, and the System Sensor SPWKL is a weatherproof wall speaker from the L-Series outdoor line built for that job. The white, plain (unmarked) housing suits exterior walls, washdown areas and other wet or dry locations used for emergency voice communication.

Key Features

  • Weatherproof to NEMA 4X and IP56 as a standalone device
  • Rated for –40°F to 151°F environments
  • Rotary switches select 25 or 70.7 Vrms speaker voltage and ¼, ½, 1 or 2 W power taps
  • Mounting plate with UL-listed waterproof wirenuts for field connections
  • Tamper-resistant construction
  • Plain white housing with no "FIRE" marking

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: System Sensor
  • Part Number: SPWKL
  • Type: L-Series outdoor speaker, wall
  • Color / Marking: White, plain
  • Nominal Voltage: 25 or 70.7 Vrms
  • Power Taps: ¼, ½, 1, 2 W
  • Sound Output: 77 / 81 / 83 / 85 dBA @ 10 ft (UL reverberant) at ¼ / ½ / 1 / 2 W
  • Frequency Range: 400–4,000 Hz
  • Max. Supervisory Voltage: 50 VDC
  • Dimensions: 6.69" L x 5.16" W x 1.72" D
  • Operating Temperature: –40°F to 151°F (–40°C to 66°C)
  • Wire Gauge: 12–18 AWG

Each VESDA-E VEA detector draws air from rooms through microbore tubes that end at small ceiling sampling points. The VSP-980-B22 is a pack of 22 black 6 mm standard sampling points for that network, and the black finish suits dark ceilings where a discreet fitting is wanted.

Key Features

  • Pack of 22 standard sampling points for 6 mm microbore tubes
  • Black finish
  • Swivel-joint inlet for flexible tube orientation
  • Blind mounting: no ceiling-void access needed once tubes are run through the ceiling
  • Screws directly to the ceiling or mounts with the included retainer
  • Fully supervised and cleaned automatically by the VEA detector

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: VESDA (Xtralis)
  • Part Number: VSP-980-B22
  • Type: VESDA-E VEA standard sampling point
  • Tube Size: 6 mm
  • Color: Black
  • Quantity: 22 per pack

Compatibility

For VESDA-E VEA aspirating smoke detectors with 6 mm microbore sampling tubes, in ceilings with a void above them. For exposed tube runs, use the VSP-982 surface-mount sampling points instead.

Built for emergency communication and other non-fire alerting, the Gentex GECA24PWW (904-1328-002) is a low-profile, wall-mount horn/strobe from the Commander3 GEC3 Colored Lens Series.
